# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and Skia m152** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite GPU backends and updates the bundled engine to Skia m152. It also adds backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback and Silk.NET Vulkan integration, improves Nano Server font support, and fixes native-object lifetime and allocation-failure leaks.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Moves the bundled renderer from m151 to m152, rolls VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.4.0 while preserving SkiaSharp's allocator fallback, and incorporates upstream font-rendering and Ganesh stability fixes, including fresh texture data after failed flushes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backends exposed** — Adds contexts, recorders, recordings, backend textures and image caching for Skia's next-generation GPU architecture, with Vulkan, Metal and Dawn support across native platforms and browser WebGPU. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback generalized** — Adds RequestReadPixels overloads to SKImage and SKSurface, callback-scoped SKImageReadPixelsResult access and copy helpers, rescale options, and GRContext.CheckAsyncWorkCompletion for deferred Ganesh work. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Silk.NET Vulkan integration added** — Introduces the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with GRSilkNetBackendContext and typed extension initialization, and makes the parameterless GRVkExtensions constructor public while retaining the SharpVk package. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Borrowed native data kept alive** — SKRegion iterators now retain their source region, while SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and WithColorType, WithColorSpace and WithAlphaType retain the ultimate pixel owner, preventing use-after-free. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Failed raster image creation no longer leaks** — SKImage.Create(SKImageInfo) now frees its unmanaged pixel buffer when native raster image creation fails. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Managed hot paths streamlined** — Speeds span-capable SKData.SaveTo calls, caches wrapper registration checks, removes an intermediate string from null-terminated text encoding, and pre-sizes SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookups. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **Caller-loaded fonts render on Nano Server** — The Nano Server native asset now uses bundled FreeType, allowing typefaces loaded through SKTypeface.FromStream, FromData or FromFile to render despite the platform's lack of DirectWrite and system fonts. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1, following HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1 in the previous release.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Updates the bundled engine to Skia m152 with upstream font-rendering, Ganesh stability and stale-readback fixes. Adds Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel readback and Silk.NET Vulkan integration; enables caller-loaded fonts on Nano Server; fixes SKRegion, SKPixmap and SKImage lifetime leaks; and speeds several managed hot paths. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280), [#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))
